mapper.sql: p.program_id AS programId, p.program_code AS programCode, p.qualification_type AS qualificationType, p.jurisdiction_code AS jurisdictionCode, p.party_type AS partyType, p.role_type AS roleType, p.tier, p.owner_partner_id AS ownerPartnerId, p.status AS programStatus, v.status AS versionStatus, v.program_version_id AS programVersionId, v.version_no AS versionNo, v.review_interval_months AS reviewIntervalMonths, v.four_eyes_required AS fourEyesRequired, v.active_slot AS activeSlot, v.approved_by AS approvedBy, v.approved_time AS approvedTime
mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_dd_program p JOIN t_dd_program_version v ON v.program_id = p.program_id WHERE BINARY p.party_type = BINARY #{partyType} AND BINARY p.role_type = BINARY #{roleType} AND BINARY p.tier = BINARY #{tier} AND BINARY p.status = BINARY 'ACTIVE' AND BINARY v.status = BINARY 'ACTIVE' AND (p.jurisdiction_code IS NULL OR BINARY p.jurisdiction_code = BINARY #{jurisdictionCode}) AND (p.owner_partner_id IS NULL OR p.owner_partner_id = #{ownerPartnerId}) ORDER BY p.program_id, v.program_version_id LIMIT 20

SELECT program_requirement_id AS programRequirementId, program_version_id AS programVersionId, requirement_code AS requirementCode, subject_role AS subjectRole, required_flag AS requiredFlag, max_age_days AS maxAgeDays, waivable_flag AS waivableFlag FROM t_dd_program_requirement WHERE program_version_id IN #{id} ORDER BY program_version_id, requirement_code LIMIT 2001

SELECT program_requirement_id AS programRequirementId, document_type AS documentType FROM t_dd_program_requirement_doc_type WHERE program_requirement_id IN #{id} ORDER BY program_requirement_id, document_type

SELECT program_check_id AS programCheckId, program_version_id AS programVersionId, check_code AS checkCode, check_type AS checkType, check_mode AS checkMode, subject_role AS subjectRole, standard_api_code AS standardApiCode, required_flag AS requiredFlag, blocking_flag AS blockingFlag, validity_days AS validityDays FROM t_dd_program_check WHERE program_version_id IN #{id} ORDER BY program_version_id, check_code

SELECT program_screening_id AS programScreeningId, program_version_id AS programVersionId, subject_role AS subjectRole, screening_type AS screeningType, standard_api_code AS standardApiCode, required_flag AS requiredFlag, monitoring_required AS monitoringRequired FROM t_dd_program_screening WHERE program_version_id IN #{id} ORDER BY program_version_id, subject_role, screening_type
